## Texts and drawings (2)

- **E0391** (text, sure): 东宫门, also 大东门, 长春园. 1780s · j83:18a · S05. https://github.com/kanripo/KR2k0036/blob/master/KR2k0036_083.txt
  > 由鑑園北山徑折而東為東宫門樓宇上下各七楹東向南北朝房各三楹其外為䕶河有石橋……東宫門亦稱大東門
  Seven-bay two-storey gate facing east, three-bay offices north and south, moat with a stone bridge outside.
- **E0392** (description, sure): Malone on the east gate of 长春园. 1934 · p.101 · S02. https://archive.org/details/historyofpekings00malo
  Said to be the gate by which Xianfeng left for Jehol in 1860, and to have been rebuilt by Cixi; stone lions, and the bridge. He reports this as hearsay, and so do we.

**On the plan:** Drawn as a gate on the plan of the gardens (S01). https://artmuseum.princeton.edu/collections/objects/138657
